Work Experience

Software development and applied machine learning, from code retrieval to deployed computer-vision systems.

Freelance Machine Learning Engineer

Bolivia / Remote

April 2025–present

I develop machine-learning systems, from data preparation and evaluation to backend services and deployment. I use Claude and Codex during software development.

  • Face attendance — delivered. Delivered a camera-based attendance system with face detection and anti-spoofing checks.
  • Coffee-shop analytics. Developed video analytics to recognize coffee-shop products, count production, and generate timestamped reports. Prepared training data with model-assisted annotation.
  • Inventory assistant — in development since September 2026. Building a WhatsApp interface for Odoo Community Edition to answer inventory and stock-movement questions; designing tests and evaluating answer quality.

Research Assistant

Huawei Research Institute · Moscow, Russia

March 2024–March 2025
  • Code retrieval. Built a patch/file retrieval pipeline and fine-tuned Jina embeddings with QLoRA, reaching 0.62 mean reciprocal rank (MRR) on SWE-bench Verified above the off-the-shelf baseline.
  • Reproducible testing. Built pipelines for creating test environments across repositories and contributed Docker environments to the SWE-bench harness.
  • Software repair experiments. Investigated how Llama 3.1 prompting and repeated sampling affect issue resolution with oracle-retrieved context; experiments resolved 77% of evaluated issues.
  • Training data. Mined and cleaned issue–patch–file pairs from open-source repositories to supervise code-retrieval models.

Languages: Spanish (native), English (fluent), and Russian (intermediate). I have teaching experience in Spanish and English.
